Landing.heroLead: For freelancers and sole traders — issue invoices, track due dates, and keep cashflow under control.
Landing.heroTrust: No credit card · company setup in minutes
Landing.featuresLead: From draft to paid stamp — without juggling five tools.
Landing.featureInvoicesBody: Line items, rates and non-VAT payer mode — numbers and VS ready to send.
Landing.featurePaymentsBody: Import bank CSV and match by variable symbol.
Landing.featureRemindersBody: Overdue overview and jobs that won't let you forget.
Landing.featureCatalogBody: Recurring items with price and VAT — onto an invoice in one click.
Landing.featureReportsBody: Monthly revenue, aging and overview without spreadsheet chaos.
Landing.featureExportBody: CSV / PDF ready to hand over — no retyping.
Landing.audienceLead: Not an ERP. A tool for invoices, due dates and cashflow — built for Slovak practice.
Landing.audienceSzcoBody: Non-VAT payer, EUR, company ID and IBAN. Invoices without spreadsheets or Word templates.
Landing.audienceFreelanceBody: Repeat clients, service catalog and a clear view of who still owes you.
Landing.audienceTeamBody: One company, shared due-date overview and export for your accountant.
Landing.stepsTitle: Three steps and you can invoice
Landing.stepsLead: Onboarding takes minutes. The next invoice even less.
Landing.step1Body: Company ID, IBAN and VAT once — then they flow into every invoice.
Landing.step2Body: Buyer with address and contact. The next invoice is faster.
Landing.step3Body: Draft → issued → due → paid. VS matches payments.
Landing.compareTitle: Instead of Excel and Word templates
Landing.compareLead: A spreadsheet can do everything — until you forget VS, a rate, or who still owes you.
Landing.sampleTitle: An invoice clients and banks recognize
Landing.sampleLead: Number, VS, due date and payment strip — ready to send. No copy-paste into a PDF template.
Landing.samplePoint3: IBAN and QR ready to fill in
Landing.trustSkBody: Company ID, tax ID, IBAN, VS and EUR — no foreign template tweaks.
Landing.trustDataBody: Company records stay in your instance; the account is separate.
Landing.trustFreeBody: Start free. Company setup and first invoice in minutes.
Landing.faqLead: Short and direct — no marketing fluff.
Landing.faq1q: Is Fakturio right for sole traders?
Landing.faq1a: Yes — non-VAT payer mode, EUR, Slovak details and payment strip are ready for everyday use.
Landing.faq2a: Upload a bank CSV. We find issued invoices by VS and mark them paid.
Landing.faq3a: In your instance. Sign-in handles a secure account; company data stays with you.
Landing.faq4a: You can start for free now. Product plans come later — no hidden trial limits.
